licence.afterExpiry.value: The Registrar may strike off a company that does not pay its annual renewal fee or late payment fine by the due date. The Registrar sends notice that the company's status will change to inactive six months after the payment due date, and the company will be struck off six months after the due date unless all outstanding payments are received, with a website notice for at least 7 days. Strike-off takes effect from the date of the website notice. A company that stays struck off for three continuous years is considered dissolved. Restoration is possible before dissolution on payment of the fees and fines due. Failure to renew the licence is also a ground for winding up.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Innovation City, late renewal (Innovation City Companies Regulations, regulations 135(1)(B)(i), 135(4), 135(7), 137 and 138, CONFIRMED.
